exceptions.reason: VI/25 identifies the physical POSS-I O exposure. During pre-detector archive preflight, the current SkyView DSS1B descriptor contained no XO197 entry and the raw XO197 header path returned HTTP 404; an independent direct STScI poss1_blue request read the official poss1_blue plate list and reported that calibration and image data were not available for the field. This is an archive-availability state, not a scientific negative and not a license to substitute a neighboring plate.
